title: C-O3 v4: `orchestrator goal start|status|list|stop` — headless goal entry point (final; spec reviews T-0081, T-0096, T-0097, T-0104 folded in; dispatched without a further spec review by Planner decision)
spec:
Supersedes T-0103. Scope is 7 files by Planner decision: the two helper extractions (bus.LOCK_NAME, spawn.resolve_secrets) belong with their only new caller, and a fourth spec-review round costs more than the risk.
IMPORT BOUNDARY (replaces the earlier rule): goals.py may import orchestrator.install.install, orchestrator.spawn.trust_workspace, orchestrator.spawn.resolve_secrets and orchestrator.bus.LOCK_NAME; it must not call any other bus.* or spawn.* function, must not construct Pool(), and must not reference orchestrator.ROOT or STATE; every target path derives from the realpath'd repo_path argument.
HELPERS: bus.py gains `LOCK_NAME = "bus.lock"` and bus.locked() uses it (tests: existing bus tests still green). spawn.py gains `resolve_secrets(mapping: dict[str, str]) -> dict[str, str]`: for each ENV_NAME, value `env:NAME` reads os.environ (missing skipped with a stderr note naming NAME), any other value runs as today's shell command; `secrets_for_role(role)` becomes a one-line wrapper over it (behaviour unchanged, existing tests green).
PRECHECKS before any write: repo_path is a git toplevel, HEAD attached, no rebase or merge in progress; target pool.toml (after install, see (a)) has [[claude_accounts]] id == account_id and [models].planner; otherwise return {"launched": false, "reason": ...} with nothing written except the install when it was needed. Add to this repo's .orchestrator/pool.toml: `planner = "claude-fable-5-1"` under [models] and `[secrets.planner] GH_WRITE_TOKEN = "env:GH_WRITE_TOKEN"`; test that Pool() constructed in the harness root (whose pool.toml is copied from this repo) exposes cfg["models"]["planner"] and cfg["secrets"]["planner"].
start(repo_path, goal_text, account_id="A", reinstall=False) -> dict: (a) install.install(repo_path) when <repo_path>/.orchestrator/pool.toml is missing or reinstall; catch SystemExit into the dict shape; (b) scaffold commit: paths = [.orchestrator, .claude, skills, .gitignore, .mcp.planner.json, .mcp.review.json, .mcp.scout.json, .mcp.triage.json]; `git status --porcelain --ignored -- <paths>`; any `!!` line → refuse {"launched": false, "reason": "<path> is gitignored in the target; worktrees would lack the scaffold"}; else `git add -- <the paths the status output names>` and commit "orchestrator: scaffold (goal start)" with the install report in the body; failure → refuse; `commit` = sha or None; (c) GOAL task: `subprocess.run(["uv", "run", "--project", <this repo>, "python", "-"], input=SCRIPT, env={**os.environ, "ORCH_ROOT": repo_path, "ORCH_GOAL_TEXT": goal_text}, check=False)`; SCRIPT is a module-level constant string with no formatting applied, ever; it reads os.environ["ORCH_GOAL_TEXT"], calls bus.create_task(title=f"GOAL: {text}"[:200], spec=text, acceptance=["Planner closes the goal with a PR"], scope=["**"], role="triage", complexity=5) and prints the id; non-zero exit or unparseable id → refuse; (d) trust_workspace(account.config_dir, repo_path); env = os.environ + CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR (expanded) + ORCH_ROOT=repo_path + CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN from the account's oauth_token_env when set + resolve_secrets(target pool.toml [secrets.planner] or {}); (e) prompt = "Skill(orchestrate) with the goal: " + goal_text + "\nThe GOAL task is " + goal_id + "; use it as the parent of every task you create and post the PR url as its result before you finish."; argv = ["claude", "-p", prompt, "--model", models.planner, "--output-format", "json", "--max-budget-usd", str(limits.max_budget_usd.get("planner", 10)), "--mcp-config", ".mcp.planner.json", "--strict-mcp-config", "--append-system-prompt", <contents of .orchestrator/prompts/planner.md>, "--dangerously-skip-permissions"]; mkdir -p runs; Popen(start_new_session=True, cwd=repo_path, stdout and stderr to runs/planner-<goal_id>.log); (f) under an fcntl flock on <repo_path>/.orchestrator/<LOCK_NAME>, append {goal_id, repo, text, pid, pid_start, started_at, account, commit, status "running"} to <repo_path>/.orchestrator/runs/goals.json; return {"launched": true, goal_id, pid, log, commit, install: report, note: "goal-Planner spend is not counted against any account budget until C-O7a tallies transcripts; the daemon may schedule other work on this account meanwhile (accepted gap)"}.
_proc_start(pid): /proc/<pid>/stat on linux; `ps -o lstart= -p <pid>` with LC_ALL=C parsed "%a %b %e %H:%M:%S %Y" local time on darwin; None elsewhere. _alive(pid): os.kill(pid, 0) in try/except. identity(record) = _alive(pid) and (pid_start is None or _proc_start(pid) is None or abs(_proc_start(pid) - pid_start) < 5).
status(repo_path, goal_id=None) -> list[dict]: per record: GOAL task status from tasks/<id>.json; children (parent == goal_id) grouped by status with hold_reason; merged shas; pr_url when the GOAL result text contains a github.com/.../pull/ url; planner_alive via identity (None plus note when _proc_start unavailable); under the flock, a "running" record failing identity is marked "exited" with exited_at. list_goals applies the same reconciliation. stop(repo_path, goal_id): identity ok → os.killpg(os.getpgid(pid), SIGTERM) and mark "stopped"; identity fails → mark "stopped" without signalling; unknown → {"error": "unknown goal"}.
.orchestrator/prompts/planner.md: the "You are the Planner" header plus the Never and Always lists copied from <this repo>/CLAUDE.md (the repo root of the orchestrator package: Path(orchestrator.__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "CLAUDE.md"), plus: "Headless: no human is in this session. When a step needs the human, write it under 'Needs the human' in plan.md and finish. The GOAL task id is given in the prompt: parent every task on it and post the PR url as its result."
cli.py: `goal start <repo> <text> [--account A] [--reinstall]` (prints fields and `revert: git revert <commit>` when a commit was made; exit 2 when not launched), `goal status <repo> [id] [--json]`, `goal list <repo>` ("no goals" when empty), `goal stop <repo> <id>`; the install command's next-step line points at `orchestrator goal start <target> "<goal>"`.
Tests tests/test_goals.py (target = harness.scratch_repo, whose .gitignore covers .orchestrator/ and .claude): start_refuses_when_scaffold_paths_are_gitignored (real git; Popen patched; not called); start_commits_scaffold_and_records_sha (ignore lines removed; real git); start_refuses_unknown_account_and_missing_planner_model_before_any_write; start_creates_goal_task_via_stdin_script_with_env (subprocess.run patched: assert input is the SCRIPT constant, env ORCH_GOAL_TEXT == text, env ORCH_ROOT == repo_path, and the marker string used as goal_text is absent from both argv and the script text); start_launches_claude_with_expected_flags_and_env (flags as listed, goal id in the prompt, CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN when configured, cwd == realpath, start_new_session); start_marks_workspace_trusted; status_reconciles_exited_and_checks_pid_identity (_proc_start patched); stop_uses_killpg_only_when_identity_matches; planner_md_matches_claude_md_lists (reads the repo-root CLAUDE.md by the path rule above); pool_parses_new_tables; bus_lock_name_shared (goals.py uses bus.LOCK_NAME and bus.locked() opens STATE / LOCK_NAME). No README change; no new dependency.
acceptance: tests/test_goals.py has the eleven named tests, green; existing bus, spawn and pool tests untouched and green

goals.py imports from orchestrator only install.install, spawn.trust_workspace, spawn.resolve_secrets and bus.LOCK_NAME (grep), never calls Pool() or other bus/spawn functions, and the GOAL-task script is a constant string with no formatting; the marker goal_text is absent from argv and script text in the test
The launch never happens when a precheck fails, a scaffold path is gitignored, the commit fails, or the GOAL-task subprocess fails; each returns launched false with a reason
spawn.secrets_for_role behaviour is unchanged (existing tests) and delegates to resolve_secrets
`uv run orchestrator goal start /nonexistent x` exits 2 with one line; `goal list <scratch repo>` prints 'no goals'
`uv run python -m unittest discover -q tests` green; no new dependency
